svg.aria-label: Item, decoding, and judge noise with their fixes; paired bootstrap of per-item differences, 10000 resamples
svg.text: The three noise layers and the paired bootstrap
fix: same items for A and B; analyze per-item differences d_i
fix: 3-5 repeats per case, then average
fix: calibrate the judge first (kappa, B.7)
Then: pair the systems, bootstrap the d_i 10,000 times with replacement,
take the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles as the 95% interval.
Zero outside the interval: the gap survives noise at the 5% level.
Cluster warning: if one judge rates 5 answers per prompt, resample by prompt, not by rating.
